1. ध्रु cl. 6. P. ध्रुव॑ति (Naigh. ii, 14) to go;
to be firm or fixed (also cl. 1. P. ध्रवति, Dhātup. xxii, 45; p. ध्रुवत्, knowing, Bhaṭṭ.; perf. दुध्राव, be killed, ib.)
2. ध्रु See अ॑स्मृत-ध्रु.
3. ध्रु See ध्वृ.

mf(आ॑)n. (prob. fr. √ धृ, but cf. √ ध्रु and ध्रुव्) fixed, firm, immovable, unchangeable, constant, lasting, permanent, eternal, RV. &c. &c. (e.g. the earth, a mountain, a pillar, a vow &c.; with स्वाङ्ग n. an inseparable member of the body, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 177; with धेनु f. a cow which stands quiet when milked, AV. xii, 1, 45; with दिश् f. the point of the heavens directly under the feet [reckoned among the quarters of the sky, cf. 2. दिश्] AV.; Br.; with स्मृति f. a strong or retentive memory, ChUp. vii, 26, 2; cf. also under करण and नक्षत्र)
